payloads.name: PS5 Home Assistant bridge
payloads.description: Connects the console to Home Assistant (HACS integration ps5-hass): state, apps with covers, launch, close and minimise apps, play time, messages on the TV, keep awake, rest mode, power off, fan threshold, start and stop payloads. Pair with a code shown on the TV.
payloads.author: Phynix88
